spans.text: [16] AR: ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ أَيْمَٰنَهُمْ جُنَّةًۭ فَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ EN: They took their [false] oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allah, and for them is a humiliating punishment.

folded.id: their mothers|are|none but those who gave birth to them
folded.subject: Their mothers
folded.object: none but those who gave birth to them

spans.text: Their mothers are none but those who gave birth to them.

folded.id: their wives|and|then [wish to] go back on what they said - then [there must be] the freeing of a slave before they touch one another
folded.subject: their wives
folded.object: then [wish to] go back on what they said - then [there must be] the freeing of a slave before they touch one another

spans.text: [3] AR: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُظَٰهِرُونَ مِن نِّسَآئِهِمْ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُوا۟ فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ تُوعَظُونَ بِهِۦ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ EN: And those who pronounce thihar from their wives and then [wish to] go back on what they said - then [there must be] the freeing of a slave before they touch one another.

folded.id: then he|will|inform them of what they did
folded.subject: Then He
folded.object: inform them of what they did

spans.text: Then He will inform them of what they did, on the Day of Resurrection.

folded.id: then|when|you do not and allah has forgiven you
folded.subject: Then
folded.object: you do not and Allah has forgiven you

spans.text: Then when you do not and Allah has forgiven you, then [at least] establish prayer and give zakah and obey Allah and His Messenger.

folded.id: there|is|in no private conversation three but that he is the fourth of them
folded.subject: There
folded.object: in no private conversation three but that He is the fourth of them

spans.text: There is in no private conversation three but that He is the fourth of them, nor are there five but that He is the sixth of them - and no less than that and no more except that He is with them [in knowledge] wherever they are.

folded.id: they|are|lying]
folded.subject: they

spans.text: They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear to untruth while they know [they are lying].

folded.id: they|are|neither of you nor of them
folded.subject: They
folded.object: neither of you nor of them

spans.text: They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear to untruth while they know [they are lying].

folded.id: they|are|not [consequently] their mothers
folded.subject: they

spans.text: [2] AR: ٱلَّذِينَ يُظَٰهِرُونَ مِنكُم مِّن نِّسَآئِهِم مَّا هُنَّ أُمَّهَٰتِهِمْ ۖ إِنْ أُمَّهَٰتُهُمْ إِلَّا ٱلَّٰٓـِٔى وَلَدْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَقُولُونَ مُنكَرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَزُورًۭا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌۭ EN: Those who pronounce thihar among you [to separate] from their wives - they are not [consequently] their mothers.

folded.id: they|are|saying an objectionable statement and a falsehood
folded.subject: they
folded.object: saying an objectionable statement and a falsehood

spans.text: And indeed, they are saying an objectionable statement and a falsehood.

folded.id: they|will|abide therein eternally
folded.subject: they

spans.text: Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally

folded.id: those|are|the companions of the fire
folded.subject: Those

spans.text: Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally

folded.id: upon allah|let|the believers rely
folded.subject: upon Allah

spans.text: And upon Allah let the believers rely.

folded.id: was evil|that|they were doing
folded.subject: was evil

spans.text: Indeed, it was evil that they were doing.

folded.id: when you|are|told
folded.subject: when you

spans.text: [11] AR: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمْ تَفَسَّحُوا۟ فِى ٱلْمَجَٰلِسِ فَٱفْسَحُوا۟ يَفْسَحِ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا قِيلَ ٱنشُزُوا۟ فَٱنشُزُوا۟ يَرْفَعِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ دَرَجَٰتٍۢ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ EN: O you who have believed, when you are told, "Space yourselves" in assemblies, then make space; Allah will make space for you.

folded.id: which they|will|[enter to] burn
folded.subject: which they

spans.text: Sufficient for them is Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the destination.

folded.id: whom you|will|be gathered
folded.subject: whom you

spans.text: And fear Allah, to whom you will be gathered.

folded.id: why|does|allah not punish us for what we say?"
folded.subject: Why
folded.object: Allah not punish us for what we say?"

spans.text: And when they come to you, they greet you with that [word] by which Allah does not greet you and say among themselves, "Why does Allah not punish us for what we say?"
